hints.title: Sign Alternation State
hints.text: Maintain pos (maximum length of subarray ending at i with positive product) and neg (maximum length with negative product).

hints.title: Transitions Based on Sign
hints.text: A positive number increments pos by 1 and neg (if positive) by 1. A negative number swaps and increments the roles of pos and neg.

hints.title: Zero Reset
hints.text: A zero element resets both pos and neg to 0 because zero can never be part of a non-zero product.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing products for all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time and risks integer overflow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Kadane-style two-variable tracking achieves optimal O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles positive, negative, and zero transitions without computing large products.
complexity.notes: Subarrays must have strictly positive product.
